description: Salesforce is a CRM platform with REST and Connect REST APIs for accessing org data.
auth_notes: Access token obtained via OAuth through a connected or external client app; token passed as Authorization Bearer header on REST calls.
gate_detail: A free Developer Edition org can be signed up for testing and development; development sandboxes also work. Production-org API availability by edition is not stated in the sources.
api_scope: REST API covers resources such as process approvals (submit, approve, reject); Connect REST API is a further REST surface. Documentation also references Salesforce CLI.
mcp_notes: Sources do not mention any MCP server.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment blocker shown for development use; production edition entitlements not covered by sources.

evidence.quote: REST API requires an access token obtained by authentication.
Developer Edition provides a free and easy solution so that you can use Salesforce for testing and development.
Create an external client app in a Salesforce org, enable OAuth, and configure an OAuth flow.

uncertainties: Webhook support is not covered by the sources.
API access entitlement by production edition is not stated.
MCP server existence is not addressed.
